alignment: For each truncated pair separately, optimize one global lag in [-20,20] M on 0.25 M grid with bounded local refinement and one complex phase, no intrinsic fit. Full-waveform replay must equal frozen published evidence within 1e-10.
cutoff_definition: Time where the high-resolution anchored NR h22 chirp crosses the named M omega22, from the prior fixed-frequency chart: sample 0.25 M, Savitzky-Golay degree 3, 20 M width, unique crossing in [-2000,100] M. Use this same cutoff time for all four waves.
expected_stop_policy: Stop on input hash/version drift, non-unique cutoff, cutoff after peak, full-waveform replay mismatch, overlap optimization boundary, residual nonclosure, or nonfinite PSD. Do not update the frozen release gate from this post-hoc result.
interpretation: Diagnostic only; selected after observing the 0.99 gate miss. A pre-peak mismatch does not isolate one physical term, and an apparent radial/quadrature Fourier residual is not uniquely a time-domain amplitude/phase or NQC attribution.
psd_protocol: Replay original 22-Msun lalsimulation SimNoisePSDaLIGOZeroDetHighPower PSD and mass-scaled geometric FFT frequencies, 10-3000 Hz band with lower bound max(10 Hz, NR relaxed reference orbital Omega/(pi*M_seconds)); original 0.25 M sampling, settled common start, conjugated h22 positive-frequency carrier, original tanh start/end time taper and next_fast_len(2*N) FFT.
purpose: Frozen post-hoc diagnostic of the already-failed SXS:BBH:2569 22-Msun detector-weighted h22 overlap, separating residual present before amplitude peak/attachment from a residual created only by the peak and ringdown.
residual_decomposition: At the optimized lag, complex least-squares scale candidate to NR. Rotate remaining Fourier-bin residual by the unit NR phasor, split real (radial) and imaginary (quadrature) weighted squared powers; their sum must equal 1-overlap^2 within 1e-10. This is algebraic, not a unique physical amplitude/phase decomposition.
